test_title: PYST 23 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: tough exams are more important than ever
Competitive exams should be made harder
Competitive exams are losing value due to new approaches
All students should avoid exams altogether

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3** i.e '**Competitive exams are losing value due to new approaches**'.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage suggests that traditional competitive exams, which require years of rigorous preparation, are being undermined or losing effectiveness due to new methods or approaches in evaluating candidates.
 
• **The emphasis** is on how the value of these exams is diminishing rather than discussing the importance of making exams tougher or the necessity to avoid them entirely.
 
• It highlights a shift away from the conventional examination methods to possibly more innovative or holistic approaches in candidate selection.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** This suggests the importance of tough exams, but the passage is more focused on the diminishing value of traditional exams. 
 
• **Option 2:** This implies a need to make exams harder, which is not the main point of the passage.
 
• **Option 4:** Suggests avoiding exams altogether, which is not advocated by the passage.
